parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: Human-readable instance name {{bibref|DNS-SD|Section 4.1.1 Instance Names}} (i.e. The "[{{param}}]" portion of the '"Service Instance Name'").

parameters.name: ApplicationProtocol
parameters.description: The Application Protocol, without the leading underscore, associated with the service (e.g., daap) as defined by the DNS-SD service {{bibref|DNS-SD|Section 7 Application Protocol Names}}.

parameters.name: TransportProtocol
parameters.description: The Transport Protocol associated with the service as defined by the DNS-SD service {{bibref|DNS-SD|Section 4.1.2 Service Names}}.

parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description: The value extracted from the Name field of the DNS SRV record {{bibref|RFC2782}} which represents the fully qualified domain name (FQDN) associated with the service as defined by the DNS-SD service {{bibref|DNS-SD|Section 4.1.3 Domain Names}}.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The value extracted from the Port field of the DNS SRV record {{bibref|RFC2782}} that is used to contact the service.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: The fully qualified domain name (FQDN) with the trailing dot "." of the target host implementing the service as in the DNS SRV record {{bibref|RFC2782}}.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the discovered {{object}} at {{param|LastUpdate}} time. {{enum}} The ability to instantiate an inactive {{object}} is OPTIONAL. The time an inactive {{object}} remains listed in this table is a local matter to the device.

parameters.name: LastUpdate
parameters.description: The date and time at which the last advertisement for this {{object}} was received.

parameters.name: Host
parameters.description: Includes all Host table entries, active or inactive, that correspond to this discovered DNS.SD service.

parameters.name: TimeToLive
parameters.description: The value extracted from the TTL field of the DNS SRV record {{bibref|RFC2782}}.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: The value extracted from the Priority field of the DNS SRV record {{bibref|RFC2782}}.

parameters.name: Weight
parameters.description: A server selection mechanism. The value extracted from the Weight field of the DNS SRV record {{bibref|RFC2782}} that specifies the relative weight for entries with the same {{param|Priority}}.

object.description: The {{object}} table contains discovered DNS-SD services. DNS.SD service information is provided in DNS RR SRV records {{bibref|RFC2782}}. The Service Instance Name {{bibref|DNS-SD|Section 4.1 Structured Instance Names}} further specifies information about the service name (RFC2782 Service field) and domain name (RFC2782 Name field) in the form: Service Instance Name = [InstanceName] . [Service] . [Domain] [Service] = _[ApplicationProtocol] . _[TransportProtocol] RFC2782 Service field will always be equal to [InstanceName]. [Service] RFC2782 Name field will always be equal to [Domain] For example, an SSH service might have: *{{param|InstanceName}} = "Secure Shell (SSH))" *{{param|ApplicationProtocol}} = "ssh" *{{param|TransportProtocol}} = "TCP" *{{param|Domain}} = "example.com" *{{param|Port}} = 22 *{{param|Target}} = "ssh.example.com."
